==Reason for Title Change==

{{quote|The narrow-faced man went on in a rant, spittle flying with his fury. “My father died at Falme! Byar told me! You witches killed him for your false Dragon! I’ll see you dead for it! I will see you burn!|Dain Bornhald}} (From {{tdr|10}})

Also, Byar actually tells Dain about his father's death while they are both at Tar Valon, not Amador. I'll change that factoid now. --[[User:Alantin|Alantin]] 20:22, 16 April 2009 (UTC)
